# Map colors of block states on the official 1.21.8 server, as a held map drew them (Circuit's probe:
# circuit-clienttest maps-probe.js, PROBE=colors). Each block's default state and each state that differs
# from it in one property, every waterloggable block's waterlogged states likewise, and blocks that need
# support placed on it, one per cell of a glass checkerboard over a stone floor; the client read each
# cell's state back. One line per state: its notation (every property, in key order) and the base color
# the map showed (0: NONE, the block beneath drawn instead; 12: WATER). States that changed after
# placement into another state of the same block are listed as that state; other changes are left out.
# The coral plants (not waterlogged) come from a terrain probe with water beside them.
